text: Sir! Machine zero two has stopped! Something is wrong with the components. We cannot continue production!
Stop the entire batch! Don't process any more components until we identify the problem!
These measurements are incorrect! We have already identified several rejected pieces!
What happened? Which production order is affected? Who supplied these specifications?
Sir, we have already consumed a significant amount of raw material. We need to check how much stock is affected!
How much material have we lost? How many units have been produced incorrectly?
I don't have the complete figures yet. I need to verify the manual stock records.
We followed the job card we received. The measurements were already written on it.
We discovered the problem during inspection. Several components are already defective.
We need to reconcile the material records before confirming the total loss.
The customer order is already delayed. We need to know when production can restart.
Where is the original job card? Who entered these measurements? Why wasn't this identified earlier?
Sometimes, a major operational crisis begins with one small mistake. A single incorrect entry, passed through disconnected manual processes, can put an entire production operation at risk.
Your manufacturing operations need more than disconnected spreadsheets, paper records and manual communication. Meet Synax ERP: one connected platform for manufacturing.
